toegepas.voor: Mense bou nie sommer enige plek
toegepas.na: Mense bou nie sommer op enige plek
toegepas.rede_vinder: The place adverbial needs the preposition 'op'; 'bou enige plek' leaves 'plek' looking like the object.
toegepas.fout: 'bou nie sommer enige plek' drops the preposition, so 'plek' reads at first as the object of 'bou'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'op' gives the place adverbial its proper form without changing who builds what or where.

toegepas.blok: Werk by die see en in die berge
toegepas.voor: om te stap en berg te klim
toegepas.na: om te stap en te bergklim
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'bergklim' is a compound verb written as one word, so the infinitive is 'te bergklim'.
toegepas.fout: 'berg te klim' splits the compound verb 'bergklim'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'te bergklim' is the standard written form and the meaning is unchanged; no protected word is touched.

toegepas.blok: Werk by die see en in die berge
toegepas.voor: Riviere en damme word weer vir hengel
toegepas.na: Riviere en damme word ook vir hengel
toegepas.rede_vinder: A Grade 5 reader takes 'weer' as 'again'; 'ook' gives the intended 'in addition' without ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'weer' in its contrastive sense is easily read as 'again' by a Grade 5 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ook' gives the intended 'in addition' plainly, keeps the protected words 'damme', 'hengel' and 'watersport', and repeats no neighbouring word.
